response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, risk_margin_count * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY time_in_force

assumptions.assumption: Orders with a NULL time in force are excluded, since NULL is not a time-in-force value. The overall total is then the matched records that have a time in force.
Share is a fraction between 0 and 1, not a percentage. The deviation is share minus the simple average of the per-time-in-force shares, so it is in the same units.
